text: Reproduced malformed OS/2 offset bug at b020199 with new SvgFontsSuite regression: 6 pass, 1 fails ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException index2147483646 in a40-byte fixture (JVM). Log /private/tmp/intaglio-font-offset-before.log, sbt exit1. Fix changes offset+10<=length to offset<=length-10 after nonnegative check, retaining unreadable-table policy. Regression covers TTF/OTF, signed/unsigned extreme offsets and last readable fsType boundary. Both SVG platform suites running.
